title: Suruchi
description: Suruchi — a boat-inspired sweet lounge that sails between Rajahmundry’s cultural heritage and modern design expression.
notes: Suruchi The Lounge takes inspiration from Rajahmundry’s riverfront spirit, translating it into a boat-shaped architectural form that celebrates movement, tradition, and joy. The dynamic façade with angular steel frames and warm interiors evokes the elegance of a vessel gliding along the Godavari. Soft lighting, golden textures, and contemporary seating create an inviting space that feels both rooted and refreshing. Blending the essence of local culture with a modern aesthetic, Suruchi stands as a symbolic destination — where design flows as smoothly as the sweetness it serves.
